sentences.en: TUTOR: Ah Caroline ... come on in.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 啊，卡罗琳……快请进。

sentences.en: Sit down.
sentences.zh: 请坐。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Thanks.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So how's the dissertation planning going?
sentences.zh: 那么，论文规划进展如何？

sentences.en: TopSage.com
sentences.zh: TopSage.com

sentences.en: TUTOR:
sentences.zh: TUTOR:

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Well Dr Schumann, I'm still having a lot of trouble deciding on a title.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 嗯，舒曼博士，我目前在确定论文题目方面仍遇到很大困难。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Well, that's perfectly normal at this stage.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 哦，这个阶段出现这种情况完全正常。

sentences.en: And this is what your tutorials will help you to do.
sentences.zh: 而你的辅导课正是为了帮助你解决这个问题。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Right.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 好的。

sentences.en: TUTOR: What we'll do is jot down some points that might help you in your decision.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 我们先记下一些可能有助于你做决定的要点。

sentences.en: First of all, you have chosen your general topic area, haven't you?
sentences.zh: 首先，你已经选定了自己的大致研究领域，对吗？

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Yes, it's the fishing industry.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 是的，是渔业产业。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Oh yes, that was one of the areas you mentioned.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 哦，对，这正是你之前提到的几个领域之一。

sentences.en: Now, what aspects of the course are you good at?
sentences.zh: 那么，课程中哪些部分你学得比较好？

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Well, I think I'm coping well with statistics, and I'm never bored by it.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 嗯，我觉得自己在统计学方面应付得不错，而且对此从不感到枯燥乏味。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Good.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 很好。

sentences.en: Anything else?
sentences.zh: 还有别的吗？

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Well, I found computer modelling fascinating - I have no problem following what's being taught, whereas quite a few of my classmates find it difficult.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 嗯，我觉得计算机建模非常有趣——我完全能跟上授课内容，而我的不少同学却觉得这部分很难。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Well, that's very good.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 哦，这非常好。

sentences.en: Do you think these might be areas you could bring into your dissertation?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这些方面是否可以融入你的论文中？

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Oh yes, if possible.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 哦，当然可以，如果可能的话。

sentences.en: It's just that I'm having difficulty thinking how can do that.
sentences.zh: 只是我一时想不出具体该如何操作。

sentences.en: You see feel I don't have sufficient background information.
sentences.zh: 您知道，我觉得自己缺乏足够的背景知识。

sentences.en: TUTOR: I see.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 我明白了。

sentences.en: Well, do you take notes?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你平时做笔记吗？

sentences.en: CAROLINE: I'm very weak at note-taking.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 我做笔记的能力非常弱。

sentences.en: My teachers always used to say that.
sentences.zh: 以前老师总是这么说。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Well, I think you really need to work on these weaknesses before any further.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 嗯，我认为你确实需要先着力弥补这些薄弱环节，然后再继续推进。

sentences.en: you go
sentences.zh: 你继续。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: What do you suggest?
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 您有什么建议？

sentences.en: TUTOR: Well, can go through the possible strategies with you and let you decide where to go from there.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 好吧，我可以跟你一起梳理一下可能采用的策略，然后由你来决定下一步怎么走。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Okay, thanks.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 好的，谢谢。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Well, some people find it helpful to organise peer-group discussions - you know, each week a different person studies a different topic and shares it with the group.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 嗯，有些人发现组织同伴小组讨论很有帮助——你知道的，每周由不同的人负责研究一个不同主题，并向小组分享成果。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Oh right.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 哦，明白了。

sentences.en: TUTOR: It really helps build confidence, you know, having to present something to others.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 这真的有助于增强信心，毕竟你需要向他人展示自己的学习成果。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: I can see that.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 我明白这一点。

sentences.en: TUTOR: The drawback is that everyone in the group seems to share the same ideas ... they keep being repeated in all the dissertations.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 不过缺点是小组里所有人似乎都持有相似的观点……结果这些观点在所有论文中反复出现。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Okay.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 好的。

sentences.en: TUTOR: You could also try a service called 'Student Support'.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 你也可以试试一个叫‘学生支持’的服务。

sentences.en: It's designed to give you a structured programme over a number of weeks to develop your skills.
sentences.zh: 它旨在为你提供为期数周的结构化课程，以提升你的技能。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Sounds good.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 听起来不错。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Yes, unfortunately there are only a few places.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 是的，可惜名额非常有限。

sentences.en: But it's worth looking into.
sentences.zh: 但还是值得去了解一下。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Yes, of course.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 是的，当然。

sentences.en: I know I've got to work on my study skills.
sentences.zh: 我知道自己必须在学习技能上下功夫。

sentences.en: TUTOR: And then there are several study skills books you can consult.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 此外，还有几本可供参考的学习技能类书籍。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Right.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 好的。

sentences.en: www.TopSage.com
sentences.zh: www.TopSage.com

sentences.en: TUTOR: They'll be a good source of reference but the problem is they are sometimes too general.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 这些书会是不错的参考资料，但问题是它们有时过于笼统。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Yes, that's what I've found.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 是的，这正是我所发现的。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Other than that would strongly advise quite simple ideas like using a card index.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 除此之外，我强烈建议采用一些非常简单的办法，比如使用卡片索引法。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Well, yes, I've never done that before.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 嗯，是的，我以前从未尝试过这种方法。

sentences.en: TUTOR.
sentences.zh: TUTOR。

sentences.en: It's simple, but it really works because you have to get points down in a small space.
sentences.zh: 这种方法很简单，但确实有效，因为你必须把要点压缩在很小的空间里。

sentences.en: Another thing always advise is don't just take your notes and forget about them.
sentences.zh: 另一点我总是建议的是：不要记完笔记就置之不理。

sentences.en: Read everything three times - that'll really fix them in your mind.
sentences.zh: 所有内容都要读三遍——这样真的能帮你牢牢记住。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Yes, I can see it'd take discipline but
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 是的，我能看出这需要自律，但……

sentences.en: TUTOR: Well, if you establish good study skills at this stage they'll be with you all your life.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 呃，如果你现阶段就培养起良好的学习技能，它们将终身受用。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Oh yes, I completely agree.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 哦，是的，我完全同意。

sentences.en: It's just that I don't seem to be able to discipline myself.
sentences.zh: 只是我似乎无法做到自律。

sentences.en: I need to talk things over.
sentences.zh: 我需要和别人讨论一下。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Well, we'll be continuing these tutorials of course.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 好的，当然，我们的辅导课还会继续进行。

sentences.en: Let's arrange next month's now.
sentences.zh: 我们来安排下个月的吧。

sentences.en: Let's see, can see you virtually any time during the week starting 22nd January.
sentences.zh: 让我看看，1月22日那一周，我几乎每天都能线上见你。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: What about the 24th?
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 24号怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm free in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我下午有空。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Sorry, I'm booked then.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 抱歉，那天我已经约满了。

sentences.en: What about the following day?
sentences.zh: 后一天呢？

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Thursday?
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 星期四？

sentences.en: I can make the morning.
sentences.zh: 我上午可以。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Fine, we'll go for the 25th then.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 好的，那就定在25号吧。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: That's great, thanks.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 太好了，谢谢！
